missions.name: Assignment: Forgemaster
missions.description: The Forgemaster is looking for someone worthy of being his successor. Prove to him that you are a master of the forge.

missions.name: The Intertrade Challenge
missions.description: Intertrade hosts a periodic challenge to earn a large number of credits through their Trade Terminal. Get the top spot on the leaderboards, and win big!

missions.name: Dead Drop
missions.description: One of our associates planted a cache of information in a nearby asteroid belt. Unfortunately, he was discovered and eliminated by Luminate Combine forces before he could convey the exact location. Head out there and tear that asteroid belt apart before our enemies recover the dead drop.
